svg.title: A team's own task runs Docker Compose through the project Taskfile: A task the team adds runs Docker Compose through PROJECT_DOCKER_COMPOSE
svg.text: A team's own task runs Docker Compose through the project
Scenario: A task the team adds runs Docker Compose through PROJECT_DOCKER_COMPOSE

g.text: Given a new project's Taskfile names its Docker Compose command at the
A new project named acme, generated with every default answer. Its project/Taskfile.yml
starts with one variable, before any task: PROJECT_DOCKER_COMPOSE, set to "cd project &&
Tasks run from the root of the project, so the command first moves into the project folder,
When the team adds a task of its own that calls PROJECT_DOCKER_COMPOSE
The team adds one task at the end of the same file: project:deploy:compose:config. Its only
command is the variable followed by config. git diff shows those lines and nothing else.
Then the team's task runs Docker Compose on the project's own compose
task prints the command it built from the variable: cd project && docker compose config.
Docker Compose then prints the configuration it read from project/docker-compose.yml, which
starts with "name: acme", the name of the project.
